'''Sernpidal shipyards''' was a ship manufacturing facility of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] located on [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]]. It was the manufacturer of the [[B-4D Legion]] bomber.
